recommendation: Keep the audit commit as-is. No core source follow-up is recommended unless a future OO decision revisits NutritionOrder request-pattern semantics.
issue_request: FHIR-14414 was a Published/Persuasive OO change request asking that NutritionRequest/NutritionOrder status use request-pattern status values and that an .intent element be added so broader request-intent options such as original-order and instance-order can be represented.
initial_application: The issue was explicitly applied in historical NutritionOrder source commits: 4d4a837d01 added request-status/request-intent bindings, NutritionOrder.intent, and example updates for #14414; 0455786229 preserved the GF#14414 spreadsheet content in a later rewrite.
additional_context: Current fhir.ini lists NutritionOrder as an active resource, while NutritionRequest is only historical/deleted. FHIR-13935 covers the MedicationRequest side and is already represented on the combined branch; FHIR-13936 covers CommunicationRequest and was resolved Not Persuasive/No Change. OO WGM minutes corroborate the FHIR-14414 motion and resolution.
reconciliation: Published an empty no-change audit commit because current active source already has NutritionOrder.status required-bound to http://hl7.org/fhir/ValueSet/request-status and NutritionOrder.intent required-bound to http://hl7.org/fhir/ValueSet/request-intent, whose code system includes the requested original-order and instance-order codes.
